metadata.title: स्वादिष्ट और स्वास्थ्यवर्धक है यह जंगली चाकोड़ साग।Tribal Kitchen।Main Bhi Bharat।Jharkhand Food
metadata.description:
The adivasis have a vast knowledge about the jungles, and the medicinal value of different plants. In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen we take you to Jharkhand again, where we cook Chakor Saag that helps in controlling blood pressure, and also helps  reduce cholesterol. 

Anchor - Shyam Sunder
